sentences: I didn't imagine we'll be growing quarterly between INR38,000 crores and INR39,000 crores on a run rate basis because that's been the case for the last two quarters now.

It actually includes a 1,047 crores increase in Stage 2 in the gold loan business, due to the short tenure schemes that we have actually launched when the new RBI guidelines came out and that has had an impact.

Overall, I would just say that the first half principally demonstrates the strength and scalability of our business model at this scale to grow 26% is I would say, good growth to be in while maintaining credit costs that, as I've said, that probably it's likely that in the 4 years, this is likely to be one of the lowest years on credit costs.

We are seized one, we have product move, we'll be proud of that moment as and when it happens, but we are also seized of the importance of resilience in our balance sheet that is needed to continue to grow from there on and get to as per last as I say INR11 lakh crores number by FY30.
management: rajeev jain (VICE CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR – BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED)
sandeep jain (CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER AND CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER – BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED)

sentences: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.
Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
I mean this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business.

I am targeting that next year we should be delivering INR100,000 crores volume between customer centricity, AI and tech transformation and digital transformation, all these three as they come together, that's really what we are aiming to do so that from a push business, we rapidly transition towards being a full business.
management: rajeev jain (VICE CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR – BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED)
anurag chottani (CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER– BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED)

sentences: And loan loss to average AR is reducing from 1.75% to 1.65% , this is really how we will report going forward as a company.
I will summarize once again, this panel principally is intended to help clearly depict the core profitability, which has seen a growth of 26% on PBT, as you can see, and 27% for PAT.
We expect that it should come back to double-digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY'27.

I'll also cover 2 key points, which will further reflect our confidence on credit cost outlook for next fiscal, which I'll cover in a moment, but GNPA, NNPA came in at 1.01% and NNPA came in at 41 basis points.

sandeep jain (CHIEF OPERATING OFFICER AND CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER – BAJAJ FINANCE LIMITED)

sentences: The annualized impact is expected to be between INR 100 crores to INR 125 crores annually.
As a result of the INR 1,416 crores, you will see two lines.
It is an improvement of 7 basis points sequentially and COF is expected to be -- we had outlined at the beginning of the year from a guidance standpoint, the number to be between 7.55% to 7.65%.

In terms of outlook, in terms of operating efficiencies, just on that from an outlook standpoint, given that we are in -- the year is virtually coming to an end, overall, we've taken a view that the top line growth or AUM growth will gravitate between 22% and 23%, but more likely to be 22% on a full year basis.
